title: A Multi-Omic Manufacturing-Readiness State Map for Cultivated Meat: Derivation of a 30-Gene qPCR Quality Control Panel
description: Multi-omic state map integrating RNA-seq transcriptomics and METAFlux metabolic flux predictions across 239 samples, defining three manufacturing readiness states. A 30-gene L1-regularized logistic regression panel achieves 96.7% cross-validation accuracy. Cross-species validation in bovine (GSE173199) and porcine (GSE206914), single-nucleus RNA-seq validation (GSE240556, 17,541 nuclei), VAE embeddings, Bayesian Gaussian mixture modeling, transcription factor enrichment (JASPAR), protein-protein interaction network (STRING), SHAP explainability, bootstrap stability analysis, and ML model comparison.
